question: Where do MOST of the world's wild lions live?

post.premise: One country holds most of the world's wild lions
post.bait: Not the one with the famous safaris you are thinking of.
post.sources_line: Tanzania Wildlife Research Institute 2024/25 census; IUCN Cat Specialist Group 2025; Gujarat Forest Department 2025

youtube.title: Where do most lions in the world live? Most people guess wrong 🦁
youtube.description:
Kenya, South Africa or the third one? One of them holds well over half of all the wild lions left on Earth, and the total left anywhere is smaller than a small town.
Guess out loud before the map fills in, then see the only place outside Africa where lions still live.
One animal fact a day you can argue about — follow along.

instagram.caption:

Which did you pick?

threads.text: Where do most of the world's wild lions live — Kenya, South Africa or Tanzania? One of them holds most of the species, the global total is smaller than a small town, and there is exactly one place outside Africa where lions still roam.

intent: The lion kingdom nobody names: three safari countries, one holds most of the world's lions — then the shock number of how few are left anywhere, and the one place outside Africa that still has them.

v04.text: Tanzania. Its latest count found around 17,000 lions, more than every other country on Earth put together.

v05.text: South Africa has about 3,000, Kenya fewer. The whole of Africa holds only about 23,000 wild lions.

v06.text: Lions have vanished from 94 percent of the land they once roamed.

v07.text: Outside Africa, only Gir, in India, still has them: 891 Asiatic lions, and nowhere else.

v08.text: Fewer than you thought. Follow us.

research.topic: Wild lion populations by country: Tanzania ~17,200 (TAWIRI national census 2024/25), South Africa 3,284, Kenya 2,515; Africa total ~22,000–25,000 (IUCN Cat Specialist Group 2025); lions occupy ~6% of historic range; India's Gir landscape 891 Asiatic lions (2025 census)

myths.myth: Kenya or South Africa, the famous safari destinations, have the most lions.
myths.reality: Tanzania's 2024/25 national census counted about 17,200 lions; South Africa follows with 3,284 and Kenya with 2,515.

landscape.our_gap: Lion Shorts are hunt clips and roar compilations; nobody plays the population map — three safari countries, the counts, how little range is left, and the single Indian forest outside Africa.

tt_range.title: World Lion Day: Only around 23,000 lions remain in wild across Africa
tt_range.notes: IUCN Cat Specialist Group: lions occupied 566,675 km² in 2025 = 6.13% of historical range

animalmap.notes: IUCN Cat SG 22,000–25,000 in Africa; Tanzania census 2024/25 ≈ 17,200; India 891 Asiatic lions (2025 census)

wiki_asiatic.title: Asiatic lion
wiki_asiatic.notes: May 2025 survey: 891 lions across 35,000 km² of Gujarat (394 in Gir NP and adjoining areas); the only wild lions outside Africa

natgeo_gir.title: Can India's last lions be saved?
natgeo_gir.notes: 2025 census: 891 Asiatic lions; Gir, Gujarat, the last wild lions outside Africa

gujarat_fd.title: 16th Lion Population Estimation, May 2025
gujarat_fd.notes: 891 Asiatic lions estimated across 35,000 km² of the Gir landscape in May 2025 (674 in 2020)
